claims.scope: For any cap-one scalar density, arbitrary translation, lambda>0 and u!=0, the translated square half-Riesz potential obeys the explicit logarithmic envelope in REPORT.md Section 2.

For arbitrary symmetric A with s3(A)>=s>0 and any invertible original-coordinate 2x2 principal pair with first scalar Schur pivot a!=0 and second scalar Schur pivot d!=0, independent cap-one inputs and arbitrary affine terms satisfy the explicit essential-density bound in REPORT.md (4.2). No pair sigma_min factor is required.
Applying the sequential two-pivot theorem to fleet03/B20 r17 with |a|>=3501/8000, |d|>1/8 and s3(A)>=1 gives ||p_Q||_infinity<67.

claims.application: Transfers the <67 interval inequality on bounded finite-union product indicators to all independent cap-one product densities with no loss.

first_unpaid_implication: Exhaust the high-leverage augmented-bank and pivot-star/heavy-edge structural states by forcing a second quantitative original-coordinate Schur pivot, a paid indefinite-pair/grouped-row certificate, a diffuse ridge/cross-bank certificate, or an already-isolated exact-null/grouped-coordinate branch.
